requirements.description: Chat fades independently when nobody is talking; speech, typing, reading and pending replies keep it available. Quiet hit boxes never block the world.
Reconstruct all catalogue items with substantially greater authored detail, larger useful world scale, readable materials, animated mechanical parts and physical contact anchors.
48 meaningful, physically distinct bespoke sequences for each item. Palette swaps, random seeds, frame counts and labels do not count as separate sequences.
Every one of 48 guests and Cheese at all nine ages participates with age/species/personality appropriate articulated motion and interaction variants.
Coordinated shared activities and object play involve independently moving participants, invitations, turn taking, contact, reactions and graceful interruption.
Actual weather, season, time, needs, mood and relationships select sensible activities; rain sends residents to reachable owned shelter with correct entry, interior occupancy and exit.
Use real gameplay state for objects, movement, ownership, quantities, rewards, saves and learning; no renderer-owned simulation or invented item grants.

Exhaustive catalogue/age/guest/context coverage, distinct-sequence evidence, rendered contact sheets and playable real-simulation scenarios; test interruptions, save migration, long runs, performance and accessibility.
Package and test the complete milestone with actual local speech/system audio, preserve verified player saves, update desktop install and verify launch.

constraints: Original ASCII spirit and approved D10 identities
Do not mark completion from coverage metadata alone
previous_goal_turn: Progress: deepened all five nest constructions with native saved bedding and 40 physical contacts across 33 existing routines. Tucks, bracing, weaving, fluffing, grit removal, leaf and feather placement, snow and toe grooves persist on the exact copy after departure or cancellation. Actual weather changes exposed materials; missing materials cannot be repeatedly conjured. Visitors now select personal settling and weather-observation routines, with species restrictions, independent positions, bounded per-stay learning and quiet gaps for mutually exclusive shared shelter scenes. Validated actual walking, contacts, original possessions/rewards, save/load/resume, storage/removal, conversation truth, all nine Cheese ages and all 48 guest rigs. Individual per-object 48-sequence repertoire, remaining constructions and full installation are still unfinished; no per-object verification counts were promoted.
